name: Bishoujo Tulpa no Mariru-chan
original_name: 美少女タルパのまりるちゃん
source:
Tulpas are illusions, conceived within one's mind.

Ruri Masato is an occult-loving shut-in NEET.
His view on women is twisted due to his gynophobia,
but one day, he creates a tulpa called Mariru.

Wait... you can have sex with a tulpa?!

Let's see what it'll be like with this innocent and pretty girl tulpa!

[Translated from [url=https://www.porontesuta.com/tarumari]official website[/url]]
translation:
Tulpas是幻象，孕育在一个人的头脑中。

瑠里正人是一位热爱神秘学、宅在家里的尼特族。
由于他的恐女症，他对女性的看法是扭曲的，
但有一天，他创造了一种名为Mariru的tulpa。

等等…你可以和tulpa发生性关系吗？！

看看这位天真烂漫的漂亮女孩tulpa会是什么样子吧！
